clang.version:
Ubuntu clang version 18.1.3 (1ubuntu1)
Target: x86_64-pc-linux-gnu
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /usr/bin

semantics: Quiet and signaling NaN constructor payloads preserve exact target encodings.
Unsigned decimal, octal and hexadecimal payloads truncate to the target significand; literals use the shared C string decoder.
Same-format copies and unary signs preserve signaling. Different-format casts quiet signaling NaNs.
The internal Quad representation retains a separate signaling flag, avoiding accidental quieting during representation-only widening.
Runtime const-char* payload arguments are type-checked and retained with ordinary C argument conversions.
Integer casts preserve range diagnostics. Quiet-NaN arithmetic, comparison and boolean results are checked.
unsupported_constant_forms: Arithmetic involving signaling NaN constants, whose compiler folding depends on operation and flags.
Leading signs/whitespace or embedded NULs in payload strings.
Nonliteral payload expressions, except char/void pointer casts directly around string literals.
limitations: Clang cross-target probes inspect constant-folded LLVM IR; native object bytes and Rust/C calls execute on Linux x86-64.
Native byte probes use volatile character reads, avoiding floating operations that could quiet signaling NaNs. Long-double padding is excluded.
GCC supports additional constant payload forms; rejected valid forms use explicit unsupported diagnostics. Runtime calls are not rejected solely because their payload is not a foldable literal.
